data.long_meaning: Manfred is a Germanic name meaning 'man's strength'. It is derived from the Old High German 'man' meaning 'man' and 'frid' meaning 'peace'. In medieval literature, Manfred is the name of a legendary figure, the last emperor of the Holy Roman Empire.
